capabilities: Organize quick notes as draggable cards in categories, groups and labels
Set alarms and recurring reminders on notes
Encrypt individual notes with a password
Embed live widgets such as clocks, calendars, countdowns, stopwatches and pomodoro timers
Track writing goals and daily activity with medals and charts
extras: Free with an optional buy-me-a-coffee donation link. Notes are stored in a single plugin data file (Quick notes board.md), not as individual vault notes; manual installation requires building with Node.js. Optional data compression makes the file non-human-readable.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated place for small throwaway notes, which end up scattered across separate files without visual organization, reminders, or quick filtering.

relations.evidence: type the name of any icon from the Lucide library
Copy a range of cells in Excel (or any spreadsheet) and paste it

summary: Sticky-note board that keeps quick Markdown notes as draggable cards in one file, with categories, labels, alarms, encryption, widgets and goals.
